name: @waifucave/moss-app-release
description: The apps' side of one release (spec §3.1): each app's install record, putting its engine under the home and starting it, the catch-up of an app behind the engine and the watch of one ahead, and the app's own updater. Shared by MOSS and MOSS Code; Node only (it runs in Electron's main process), and it imports the protocol and the update feed, never the core.
